title: 'Terrorist pilot planned to crash plane': Israel security minister on flydubai cockpit incident
summary_full: Israel's National Security Minister has denounced a terrifying incident on a flydubai flight traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv, where a pilot was stabbed, igniting fear among the 180 onboard passengers, which included numerous Israelis. Quick thinking by passengers and two other pilots averted a disaster, resulting in a safe diversion landing in Saudi Arabia.
